name: uml-studio-v7
description: Browser-based UML Studio with SQLite and IndexedDB recovery

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:server
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:py
scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:py
scripts.format:check: npm run format:js:check && npm run format:py:check
scripts.format:js: prettier --write package.json package-lock.json playwright.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs '.github/workflows/*.yml' 'tests/e2e/**/*.mjs'
scripts.format:js:check: prettier --check package.json package-lock.json playwright.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs '.github/workflows/*.yml' 'tests/e2e/**/*.mjs'
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:server && npm run test:e2e
